patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I fell on my arm playing football and my shoulder popped out of place — I can feel it's not sitting right. I'm holding it away from my body because I can't move it at all.
clinical.presentationShort: 22yo M — anterior shoulder dislocation, arm held in slight abduction/ER, squared-off deltoid, NV intact — reduce.
clinical.presentationLong: 22-year-old male with an anterior shoulder dislocation after a fall, arm held in slight abduction and external rotation with a squared-off deltoid, neurovascularly intact.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → X-ray, procedural sedation & reduction, sling, check NV before/after; discharge.
diagnosis.why: Squared-off shoulder + arm held out = anterior dislocation. Imaging plus procedural sedation and reduction make this an Acute resource case. Check axillary nerve before and after reduction.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, cradling one arm held slightly away from the body
signs: arm held away from the body
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 22-year-old man in a football jersey, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: cradling one arm held slightly away from his body, unable to move it. Expression: pained and tense. Clearly visible: an arm held out from the body and a squared-off shoulder. No text, no logos.
